title: fix(fields): tags, lookup and people pickers leave an IME-owned Enter to the input method
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_
Fixes #35797
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a keyboard bug fix inside three field widgets; no metadata key, value or authoring guidance moves

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用中文、日文、韩文输入法的用户,在标签字段、查找字段的搜索框、选人框的搜索框里按回车选词时,不会再被误加成标签或误选中记录;选完词后再按一次回车照旧生效。
- 为什么做:这是列表行内编辑大项的遗留问题,表格自己已经修过同样的输入法问题,这三个字段控件还没修。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是这三个控件在输入法状态下回车不起作用,用户再按一次回车即可;可直接撤回,不涉及任何数据。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

`TagsField` (Enter and comma), and the search boxes of `LookupField` and `PeoplePicker` (Enter picks the highlighted entry, the arrows move it), now return early on a key the input method owns: one pressed while a composition is open (`isComposing`, keyCode 229), or the Enter Safari raises just after `compositionend` with keyCode 229. The next Enter (or comma) does what it always did.

- **One predicate.** All three widgets ask `isImeKey` in a new package-internal module, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeKey.ts`. Nothing re-exports it from the `@object-ui/fields` entry (measured below).
- **Why not the grid's `isImeKey`.** The grid's predicate lives in `@object-ui/components` at `renderers/complex/dataTableCellSelection.ts` and is not on that package's entry: its exports map is `.` and `./style.css`, and the entry does not re-export the module. `@object-ui/fields` can only reach it if `@object-ui/components` adds a new export to its published entry, which is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. No lower package that both import (`@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/types`) carries a keyboard helper or a subpath that could hold one without the same widening. So the fields copy is a second definition of the same one-line predicate, said in its doc comment; nothing checks that the two still agree. The seat ruled (card #35797 comment 7057636936) that the card's "one shared helper" means one predicate inside `@object-ui/fields`; collapsing it with the grid's copy is follow-up #35996.
- **Whole handler, not only Enter.** The guard sits at the top of each handler, as the grid's does, so the arrow keys that move between candidates inside the input method no longer move the highlighted row, and Backspace inside a composition no longer reaches the remove-last-chip branch. Pinned for the arrows.
- **Shared site?** No. Each search box is a plain `Input` from `@object-ui/components` with the widget's own `onKeyDown`; no combobox or command primitive owns the Enter. The fix reaches exactly these three widgets, wherever they are mounted: the record form, the list grid's cell editors, and the action parameter dialog.

## Tests

`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeComposition-35797.test.tsx` (new): for each widget, a Chromium/Firefox sequence (`compositionstart`, keydown Enter with `isComposing: true` and keyCode 229, `compositionend`) and Safari's sequence (`compositionstart`, `compositionend`, keydown Enter keyCode 229 with `isComposing` false). Each case ends with the control: a plain Enter (keyCode 13) adds the tag or takes the row, so a guard that swallowed every Enter goes red too. Plus TagsField's comma, PeoplePicker's arrow key inside a composition, and the predicate's truth table.

<details><summary>Pin run and per-widget ablation</summary>

Pins at the fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

Ablation, one widget at a time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `if (isImeKey(e)) return;` hit once and replaced, blob moved, restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after each). The test imports the widgets from `src` by relative path, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Guard removed from | Result | Failing tests |
|---|---|---|
| `TagsField` | 3 failed / 7 passed | Chromium Enter, Safari Enter, comma |
| `LookupField` | 2 failed / 8 passed | Chromium Enter, Safari Enter |
| `PeoplePicker` | 3 failed / 7 passed | Chromium Enter, Safari Enter, arrow key |

Each ablation reds only its own widget's cases.
</details>

<details><summary>Chromium with a real composition (CDP)</summary>

A scratch page bundled the three widgets from this branch's `src` and ran in Chromium 1243 (Playwright 1.63, headless). Composition was driven with CDP `Input.imeSetComposition`, the candidate-picking key with `Input.dispatchKeyEvent` (virtual key 229), and the commit with `Input.insertText`. `isComposing` was not set by the script: Chromium reported `isComposing: true` on its own, from the open composition. The log read `compositionstart`, keydown Enter 229 `isComposing: true`, `compositionend` in all three widgets.

| Step | Fixed branch | Predicate forced to `false` (control) |
|---|---|---|
| Tags: IME Enter on `ni`, then commit | no tag; draft holds the committed word | tag `ni` added (the half-typed pinyin) |
| Tags: next plain Enter | the committed word added as a tag | the committed word added as a second tag |
| Lookup: search `Mar`, IME Enter after the answer | no value; 1 option still open | value `r2` taken, list closed |
| Lookup: next plain Enter | `r2` taken | n/a |
| People: IME ArrowDown + Enter after the answer | nobody selected | `u1` selected |
| People: ArrowDown + plain Enter | `u1` selected | n/a |

Safari: NOT MEASURED in a browser. No WebKit build is installed in this container (only `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium*`), and the container rule forbids `playwright install`. Safari's post-composition 229 Enter is pinned in jsdom as above.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Same class, other widgets in this package, not changed here.** Read only, not reproduced: `GridField`'s cell `onKeyDown` (Enter moves to the next row), `DatePickerField`'s typed-text Enter commit, and `RecordPickerDialog`'s page-jump Enter read Enter with no composition guard. Per the seat's ruling (card #35797 comment 7057636936) they move to follow-up #35996 (Blocked-by this PR).
- **Two definitions of one predicate.** The grid's `isImeKey` in `@object-ui/components` and the fields module are byte-identical today; nothing checks that they stay so. Collapsing them to one needs either a new export on the components entry (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`) or a home in a lower package; per the seat's ruling (card #35797 comment 7057636936) that is follow-up #35996.

## Verification

Read first: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeKey.ts` (the predicate and why it is a second copy), then the guard line in `PeoplePicker.tsx` and `LookupField.tsx`, whose handlers also own the arrow keys.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/imeComposition-35797.test.tsx`. Expect `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

<details><summary>Local gates and package runs</summary>

All at head `cf02f7c1`, on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`.

- Closure build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` shows the new test in the test program and `imeKey.ts` in the source program): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields build`: exit 0. No new entry export: `isImeKey` appears 0 times in `dist/index.d.ts` (control: `TagsField` appears 2 times there). The module's own `dist/widgets/imeKey.d.ts` is a per-file declaration like the 104 other widget declarations, and the exports map reaches only `.` and `./style.css`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/`: `Test Files 309 passed | 1 skipped (310)`, `Tests 4700 passed | 7 skipped (4707)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 38 families derived; all 38 run, exit 0 each. `--ran` reconciliation: `38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- `eslint` on the five touched source files: 0 errors; the 80 warnings are all on lines this diff does not touch in `LookupField.tsx` and `PeoplePicker.tsx`, and the two new files have none.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): `0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: `origin/main: merges cleanly`, `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
- Left to CI: `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` and the repo-wide lanes. The five type-check program steps and the CI-measured-only families that `dispatch-gates` names are NOT MEASURED locally.
</details>
